name: Contract Balance 1
definition: Balance details of a registered contract.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of the contract balance.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Currency and amount of money of the contract balance.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the balance is a credit or a debit balance. A zero balance is considered to be a credit balance.
